## Validation and files

All 22 screened relevant records were used during development, and the strategy retrieved all 22. This is **100% relative recall against the development set**, not sensitivity. There was no held-out validation set, so the strategy remains empirically unvalidated on independent records. The optional-block loss samples were small, which leaves a risk of missed eligible studies.

The protected report passed validation. The audit records the rationale, search history, reviewer dispositions, and limitations; the supplementary notes summarize assumptions and risks.
